purpose: Freeze the data boundary, causal-input boundary, and release criteria for an opt-in magnetic source-quality supervisor. The protocol does not authorize a runtime gate by itself.

baseline.explicit_non_goal: This protocol does not change the current ESKF to a full three-dimensional magnetic-vector update.
baseline.known_failure: Magnitude EMA and pseudo-NIS accepted every physical indoor_1 update while magnetometer-on ESKF materially degraded against independent OptiTrack attitude.

allowed_use: derive a local magnetic datum already declared by the replay contract
select only among predeclared candidate structures
report offline truth-scored source and estimator effects

opened_diagnostic_holdout.policy: Not available for candidate selection, threshold tuning, or release qualification because its results were already inspected. Retain only as historical adverse evidence.

sealed_first_holdout.policy: Do not download, inspect, or convert until a candidate code commit and configuration fingerprint are frozen. It may receive an independent local calibration only for frame/time/datum setup; supervisor thresholds and state-machine logic must remain unchanged.

sealed_replication.policy: Run only after indoor_2 with exactly the same frozen candidate commit and configuration. No result-driven changes are permitted between indoor_2 and indoor_3.

allowed: physical gyroscope samples available causally before the candidate decision
source identifier, generation, finite-value status, validity, and freshness
sequential latch and recovery state derived only from earlier candidate decisions
forbidden: reference quaternion or any ground-truth pose
truth yaw, estimated-output error, future samples, or trajectory identity
flight command labels, manually selected trouble intervals, or holdout-specific thresholds
an always-reject policy presented as protection
runtime_input_boundary.fundamental_limit: A slow persistent magnetic heading shift with near-constant field magnitude is not distinguishable from yaw drift using IMU plus magnetometer alone. An independent heading source, calibration constraint, or environment constraint is required to resolve that ambiguity.

required_stages: apply the existing ESKF update only when the evaluator permits it
commit accepted baseline and recovery history only after the core update outcome is known
required_fault_coverage: stale timestamp, delay, loss, and reordering
required_properties: fail closed on malformed input and stale source metadata
bounded rejection latch with explicit recovery evidence
separate evaluator decision from accepted ESKF innovation
diagnostic reason codes and update coverage accounting

always_report: geodesic, tilt, and wrapped-yaw RMSE/P95/max against independent truth where available
magnetometer update coverage, acceptance, rejection reason, latch count, and recovery time
false acceptance by offline physical heading-residual bin
numerical health, covariance checks, and any ESKF recovery/reset
comparison with magnetometer-off and unsupervised-magnetometer baselines
must_not_pass_by: worsening tilt beyond the frozen tolerance while only improving a selected yaw interval
using truth, future samples, or sequence identity in the runtime decision
release_metrics.selection_rule: Select a candidate only after calibration/development evidence shows reduced false acceptance in adverse bins while retaining declared usable coverage and no unexplained degradation relative to both baselines. Numerical thresholds must be added in a versioned amendment before selection, not after opening indoor_2.

provenance_requirements: raw-input, replay, runner, candidate-source, and configuration SHA-256
Git commit and clean/dirty worktree state
strict build, unit, synthetic fault, and external-data result logs
